description: Swap in new HTML for a drop you already published — same URL/slug, new HTML. On the hosted tier every update is kept as a new version, so it can be undone with rollback_site. (Set a password to re-lock; zero-knowledge means content can't be re-keyed without re-supplying it.)

to.description: Where to publish instead of your personal space: a team handle ('acme') you're on, or '<owner>/<slug>' for a drop someone made you an editor of. See list_teams / list_shared_with_me.

name: update_site
title: Update a drop in place
